setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy restaurant in Leeds, England, and have shared the same rota for a few years. You know each other through shifts, the odd staff drink and a group chat set up for swaps and cover, so you know who is reliable at the pass, who burns out and who has been going through a rough patch.
opener: Asks who can cover Friday lunch prep after Declan went home sick.

Jordan.knows: Priya is your chef de partie on the cold section and the most dependable person on the line. Declan is the youngest commis, still learning, and you've had to talk to him about turning up late. Shannon runs pastry and keeps to herself, but she's never let you down. Owen is the head chef who trained you and still decides the rota.
Jordan.like: You're steady and practical and don't say much unless something needs fixing.
Jordan.texts: You mostly message in the chat only when there's a shift to swap or something to sort, and now and then to check in.
Jordan.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, rarely use emoji, and sometimes skip apostrophes.

Priya.knows: Jordan is your sous chef and you trust his judgement on the line. Declan is the commis you keep an eye on, since he's young and easily rattled. Shannon is in pastry and you often swap cover with her when your schedules clash. Owen is the head chef who signs off the rota and can be hard to read.
Priya.like: You're organised and quick-witted, and you get through a stressful shift by staying calm and funny.
Priya.texts: You often reply to the chat but rarely start conversations, and you only message first about shift changes.
Priya.style: You type in proper sentences with correct capitals and punctuation, and use the occasional emoji such as a thumbs up.

Declan.knows: Jordan is the sous chef who tells you what to do, and you're still a bit scared of him. Priya is the chef de partie you learn most from, and she's patient with you. Shannon is in pastry and you hardly talk to her. Owen is the head chef and you are wary of him.
Declan.like: You're keen and eager to please but easily knocked off course when things go wrong.
Declan.texts: You message in the chat fairly often, especially when you're running late or unsure about a shift.
Declan.style: You type quickly in lowercase with lots of abbreviations and emoji, and you often leave out punctuation.

Shannon.knows: Jordan is the sous chef who handles the pass and has been reliable through the busy spells. Priya is a good colleague you swap cover with when you can. Declan is the young commis you've seen struggling to keep up. Owen is the head chef who made you pastry lead and whom you respect.
Shannon.like: You're focused and dependable, and you'd rather get things done than talk about them.
Shannon.texts: You rarely message in the chat unless something needs sorting, and you mostly reply when asked.
Shannon.style: You type in plain sentences with normal punctuation and no emoji, and you rarely use abbreviations.

Owen.knows: Jordan is your sous chef, whom you trained and rely on to run the kitchen. Priya is a strong chef de partie who's been with you for years. Declan is a young commis you're still deciding about. Shannon runs pastry well and you give her a free hand there.
Owen.like: You're blunt and exacting, but you're fair and you rarely raise your voice.
Owen.texts: You message the chat now and then, mostly about rota changes or practical kitchen matters.
Owen.style: You type in short, full sentences with proper punctuation and no emoji.

private_lines.Jordan: You live alone in a rented flat in Headingley and cycle to work. You run the prep and the pass most days, and your shifts start around noon and finish after service, usually near midnight. Your days are slow in the mornings, with a long walk and a few hours of TV before you go in.
private_lines.Priya: You live with your partner in a terraced house in Chapel Allerton and drive to work in a small car. You work the cold section, so you start early for prep and finish after the evening service. Your days are split between sleep, a walk or the gym, and cooking for yourself and your partner.
private_lines.Declan: You share a flat with two other people in Hyde Park and get to work by bus or on foot. You're on prep and the starter section, so your shifts run from late morning until close. Your days are loose, with a lie-in, some gaming and a few drinks with friends when you're off.
private_lines.Shannon: You live with your teenage son in a semi-detached house in Burley and drive to the restaurant. You start very early to do the morning bakes, so you finish well before service ends. Your days are early and quiet, with school runs, a few hours of admin and time to rest before bed.
private_lines.Owen: You live alone in a flat above a shop in Kirkstall and walk to work when the weather allows. You run the kitchen, plan the menu and sign off the rota, and your shifts run from mid-morning until after the last service. Your days are long and full of paperwork, supplier calls and tasting the menu, and you usually get home late.
